title: Domain Vet - Domain History & Health Auditor Input

domain.title: Domain name
domain.description: Domain name to audit (e.g., example.com, star.ai, stripe.com). Protocol prefixes (http/https) and trailing slashes are automatically sanitized.
domain.sectionDescription: Specify the domain to undergo forensic history and health analysis

sensitivity.title: Spam detection sensitivity
sensitivity.description: Strictness of toxic, gambling, pharmaceutical, and spam keyword detection across archive.org records.
sensitivity.sectionDescription: Configure historical snapshot sampling and forensic sensitivity thresholds

maxSnapshots.title: Historical snapshots limit
maxSnapshots.description: Maximum number of archive.org snapshots sampled across the domain's chronological timeline.

checkEmailSecurity.title: Audit email security (SPF/DMARC)
checkEmailSecurity.description: Inspect SPF and DMARC DNS policies to assess sender spoofing resilience and Google/Yahoo sender policy compliance.

checkPbnFootprint.title: Detect PBN & parking footprint
checkPbnFootprint.description: Analyze historical archive HTML and nameservers for domain parking services, expired domain holding pages, and PBN link networks.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy or custom proxies to bypass rate-limiting when querying external archive and WHOIS sources.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Configure proxies to ensure unthrottled access to Wayback Machine and DNS endpoints
